nodes.label: Associate DICOM to Project (admin action)
nodes.rationale: Django admin custom action template: associates selected DICOMStudy rows with a project via the associate_dicom_files_to_project admin action.

nodes.label: FK Relationship Tracking
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes forward vs reverse FKs and traces complete path from any table to Patient; avoids cycles with visited set; enables hierarchical table display.

nodes.label: Schema Discovery Service
nodes.rationale: Introspects client_app Django models via _meta API to auto-populate DatabaseTable/DatabaseField; maps Django types to Pydantic; tracks FK direction and full patient_path.

nodes.label: Per-Table Stage-2 Extraction
nodes.rationale: One focused LLM call per table, parents before children; child calls receive parent records and attach via parent_index; gap-fill re-ask passes (max 2); single-parent orphan rescue; completed tables saved even if later calls fail (job finishes 'partial').

nodes.label: API Connection Testing
nodes.rationale: Validates LLM credentials before use; provider-specific routing (OpenAI/Azure, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, generic); adaptive timeout 120s local / 30s remote.

nodes.label: Pydantic Model Builder
nodes.rationale: Generates type-safe Pydantic BaseModel classes from ResponseModel config; validates via syntax check, runtime check, empty + sample instantiation.

nodes.label: Extraction Wizard Flow
nodes.rationale: 4-step session-based wizard: select client config -> select tables (hierarchical) -> select fields -> review/validate Pydantic model.

nodes.label: Step 10 Missing FK Relationships
nodes.rationale: Checks that selected fields cover model relationships; prompts user to link to existing parent records or create new ones when FK parents (e.g. Diagnosis, Pathology) are missing.

nodes.label: CSV Data Import Workflow
nodes.rationale: 12-step import from CSV into client_app models, starting from Patient; respects model FK hierarchy; excluded models: PatientDicomFile, DICOMStudy, DICOMStudyProject, BulkDICOMUpload, UnprocessedDICOMStudies, BulkDICOMUploadSession, BulkDICOMStudyMatch.

nodes.label: Group FK by Parent Model
nodes.rationale: Groups FK relationships by parent_model instead of child model so one parent (e.g. Diagnosis) is created/linked once and shared by all child models, preventing duplicate parents.

nodes.label: Dynamic Model Introspection
nodes.rationale: Field lists must be generated dynamically from models, never hard-coded; a model/field introspection service is required.

nodes.label: Model Hierarchy Constraint
nodes.rationale: User must import one relationship level at a time (e.g. Pathology but not Symptom); parent models remain available for mapping even if not selected; Patient always available.

nodes.label: Archive Operator Role
nodes.rationale: Partial access: view_archivedstudy, add_archivedstudy, view_archivelocation - can browse/trigger archive but not reconfigure or manage locations.

nodes.label: Archive Viewer Role
nodes.rationale: Read-only: view_archivedstudy, view_archiveconfiguration - dashboard and lists only, trigger buttons hidden.

nodes.label: DICOM Administrator Role
nodes.rationale: Full archive permission set shipped in the DICOM Administrator group via migration client_app/0031_dicom_administrator_archive_permissions.py.

nodes.label: DICOM Archive Permissions
nodes.rationale: Plain Django model permissions auto-created by migration; is_staff alone grants none; each view gated by a specific permission (view/change/add/delete on ArchiveConfiguration, ArchiveLocation, ArchivedStudy).
